rows.label: tlk70000120_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey! I'm Elba, the brave warrior of
Gula! Nice to meet you!

rows.label: tlk70000120_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Anyway, look at this weapon! The chief
just gave it to me the other day!

rows.label: tlk70000120_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Did you know? If you keep using a
weapon, the skills it can unleash
will grow too! That's important!

rows.label: tlk70000120_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Just you wait! I'll train and train
with this as my partner, and someday
I'll become Gula's greatest warrior!
